description: Seed table from the 2026 Kültepe/Kaniš name-semantics research, revised after the Kt 86/k 41 / KT 12 dossier. A row is an attestation hypothesis, not a translation. Confidence is per claim-type (attestation / language / parse), not a single score for the name. Names at D for attestation are excluded from any numerator. Source: Kultepe-name-semantics-deep-research.md §10; kt86k41.json.
control_set: ordinary Old Assyrian legal and commercial vocabulary, coded with the same semantic ontology
